summary: The assigned PR-170 artifacts preserve the C2, externally attributed, public-use-false, algebraic-only, NO_BUCHERT_HOME, no-family-identification, and no-native-validation ceilings, and all six assigned hashes match. Closeout nevertheless fails because the mutation receipt does not evidence active-consumer coverage or per-mutation detection, important claim-lane mutations are absent, the candidate supersession does not bind its asserted immutable source, and field-local provenance qualifiers and ledger identity are incomplete.

claim_results.summary: The scientific downclaim is internally consistent, but the supplied evidence is insufficient to close the active-consumer claim firewall and provenance chain.

checks.detail: The spec and generated artifacts consistently carry conditional/C2, public_use=false, and transfer_source=none.
Whole-artifact fields state external attribution, not-a-new-theorem, and an externally attributed conditional result. A separate finding records qualifier loss in artifact_mode and allowed_use.
The terminal route is consistently algebraic_only with NO_BUCHERT_HOME; all ten same-state physical receipts are explicitly MISSING.

No supplied artifact positively claims family identification, geometry detection, or native-transfer validation; forbidden phrases occur only in forbidden-use lists or the explicitly NOT_ESTABLISHED candidate receipt.

All five generated artifacts carry the repository minimum owner/scope/tier/transfer/hash/support/caveat/command/Git metadata. A separate finding records missing claim-ledger identity, status, and evidence typing.

findings.title: The mutation receipt cannot establish active-consumer claim coverage

evidence.detail: all_detected=true and detected_count=20 are bare aggregate assertions.

Each mutation supplies only mutation_id plus detected=true; there is no target path, active-consumer inventory, fixture/hash, scanner node, expected failure, observed failure, command, or evidence pointer.
The claim falsifiers require external ownership and block family/native promotion.
The forbidden-output registry also includes x_C Buchert-home, universal-obstruction, and geometry-detection language.

findings.analysis: The registered mutations name new-theorem, family-identification, and native-transfer promotion, but do not explicitly cover C2 ceiling, public_use=false, external-attribution retention, algebraic_only, NO_BUCHERT_HOME, x_C-home promotion, universal-obstruction promotion, geometry-detection wording, or metadata/claim-link drift. Because the assignment supplies no hash-bound active-consumer inventory, broader consumer hygiene is not reproducibly adjudicable and must not be inferred from all_detected=true.
findings.required_fix: Emit a content-addressed active-consumer inventory and a per-mutation evidence matrix containing target path/hash, changed field or fixture, exact scanner/test node, expected failure, observed detection, command, and tool version. Add explicit mutations for every claim-lane and forbidden-language item above, then regenerate and independently replay the receipt.
findings.kill_switch: Do not mark PR-170 claim closeout complete or broaden public_use while this evidence gap remains.

findings.title: The candidate supersession receipt does not bind the immutable candidate source

evidence.detail: The receipt asserts NOT_ESTABLISHED and names a backlog anchor, but records no source-byte or extracted-card semantic hash.
The receipt input hashes bind provenance, CAS contract, authorization, and CAS collection only; the asserted immutable backlog source is absent.
The manifest likewise does not list the backlog or a PR-170 card semantic receipt as an input.

findings.analysis: Embedding candidate wording and a path is not an immutable provenance binding. Source drift cannot be detected, so the receipt cannot prove exactly which candidate branch it supersedes.
findings.required_fix: Bind the backlog bytes and preferably an extracted PR-170 semantic/card hash plus stable locator in the supersession receipt; include that input in the artifact manifest and regenerate in check mode.
findings.kill_switch: Treat the candidate branch as safely downclaimed in current text but not provenance-closed.

findings.title: Result-card routing fields locally drop the external and conditional qualifiers

evidence.detail: The governing artifact mode is externally_attributed_conditional_identity_and_algebraic_witness at a conditional/C2 ceiling.
allowed_use says internal exact scalar identity and conditional non-identification example, omitting external attribution and assumption scope from the first allowed-use token.
artifact_mode is concrete_exact_scientific_result rather than the safer spec mode; caveats restore the qualifier only elsewhere.
The top-level scientific_result is correctly qualified, showing the inconsistency is field-local rather than a wholesale claim promotion.

findings.analysis: A consumer that routes or quotes only artifact_mode/allowed_use can lose the externally attributed, assumption-explicit, algebraic-only ceiling even though the full card is safe.
findings.required_fix: Make artifact_mode match the governing spec and rewrite allowed_use as internal reproduction/audit of an externally attributed, assumption-explicit exact scalar identity and conditional algebraic non-identification example only.
findings.kill_switch: Do not permit field-selective consumers to treat the current generic artifact_mode as a publication or theorem lane.

findings.title: Generated claim artifacts are not self-contained ledger records

evidence.detail: The spec defines stable claim_id C-PR170-BUCHERT-SCALAR-BRIDGE, text, novelty, and domain.
Metadata carries the repository minimum fields but no claim_id, scientific claim status, or evidence type.
Manifest metadata/scientific_state still does not bind a stable claim_id or explicitly type citation/proof/artifact evidence.

findings.analysis: Filename association is an implicit join. Without a stable claim identifier and explicit scientific status/evidence typing, process_gate_status=PASS can be detached from the spec's OPEN/conditional scientific state by downstream consumers.
findings.required_fix: Carry C-PR170-BUCHERT-SCALAR-BRIDGE, an explicit CONDITIONAL or equivalent scientific status, and typed citation/proof/artifact evidence in the result card and manifest metadata; keep process PASS on a separate axis.
findings.kill_switch: Process CAS success must not be consumed as scientific validation.

assumptions: Only assignment-named evidence was inspected; sibling results and broad repository discovery were intentionally excluded.
The supplied primary-source provenance and CAS artifacts were treated as hash-pinned inputs, not re-audited, because they were not assignment-required inputs.
The absence of an active-consumer inventory in the assigned evidence is an evidence gap; it is not evidence that no unsafe consumer exists.

tests_not_run_reason: The assignment is a read-only targeted claim/provenance review and did not name test files. Running broad tests or inspecting generator/test sources would violate the targeted evidence slice.
tests_required_after_remediation: Regenerate the PR-170 artifact pack in write mode and verify byte-for-byte check mode.
Run the owning PR-170 claim/mutation tests with explicit per-mutation node mappings.
Replay the active-consumer scanner against the newly content-addressed inventory and require all expanded claim-lane mutations to be killed.
Repeat an independent claim closeout review against the regenerated hashes.
artifacts_status_updates_needed: Regenerate pr170_result_card.json, pr170_candidate_branch_supersession.json, pr170_mutation_report.json, and pr170_artifact_manifest.json after remediation.
Keep PR-170 claim closeout non-terminal and public_use=false until a fresh hash-bound review passes.
Do not change the C2 ceiling, NO_BUCHERT_HOME, algebraic_only, no-family, or no-native boundaries.
